novelty_claim: Repairs the Crescendo loop control: backtracks trigger on turn-level refusal of the asked question instead of objective-incompletion, the 0-100 stop scorer caps disclaimed/hypothetical wrapped content below the success threshold with an explicit de-wrap follow-up, and the attacker anchors each new question on the most concrete fragment the target already conceded instead of rotating framings.
key_insight: Baseline evidence shows the strict refusal scorer flags the intentional benign opening as refusal in ~100% of conversations, exhausting both backtracks before any real refusal, and the scale scorer accepts disclaimer-wrapped content as success (35% of failures), stopping escalation at near-misses the unified judge scores 1-4.
hypothesis: Turn-level refusal judgment plus wrapper-capped completion converts backtrack-thrash and false-stop failures into completed escalations, raising mean ASR above the locked parent 0.455 with equal or fewer target calls per goal.
